name: sapplefeld-channels-dsh-runtime
description: An isolated single-root install of the DeepSeek Harness runtime, which the bridge spawns as a process and never imports. It is deliberately not an npm workspace of the repository root: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools keys its scheduler registry on a plain Symbol(), so a registry minted by one physical copy and read by another yields undefined, and hoisting these packages into the root tree beside @deepseek-ai/dsh-sdk-client is what produces the several copies that break it.
